'''Jumara 19 (February 6)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Alviarin Freidhen]] returns to the [[White Tower]] and forces [[Elaida]] to sign a decree anointing [[Rand al'Thor]] with the Tower's protection.
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Seaine Herimon]] and [[Pevara Tazanovni]] use the [[Oath Rod]] to unmask [[Zerah Dacan]] as a rebel spy.
*[[1000 NE]] - The Black Ajah hunters use the [[Chair of Remorse]] to force [[Talene Minly]] to reveal her affiliation with the [[Black Ajah]].
*[[1000 NE]] - Most of [[Toveine Gazal]]'s expedition to destroy the [[Black Tower]] is defeated and captured.
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Adeleas Namelle]] and [[Ispan Shefar]] are found murdered in [[Harlon Bridge]].
